text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, getting pumped up now...! Will Kris 
S win again? Or will Tap Dance City cause 
an upset?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seems like everyone is keeping an eye on 
Symboli Kris S, huh. Before you know it, 
she's right at the center of everything—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...An unprecedented, dense presence. It's 
obvious—who this belongs to.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —I've been waiting for you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The storm, the trial that is you... 
Today's the day I'll finally—surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
âI'll show you! I'll show every last one 
of you here!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just who it is that runs the hottest, 
freest, and most "romantic" race in the 
world!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"And carve it into your mind!! My name! 
Tap Dance City!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Tap-p!! If it's you, Tap, you 
can take down Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Tap Dance City!! Show us the 
ultimate 'Romance'--!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...You are passionate, just as I thought. 
And... powerful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is why I... shall remain cold.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's awesome! ――Let's make this one 
hell of a race."
